# Bluebird Happiness — G4 background pegasus

[![Bluebird Happiness in “Winter Wrap Up” — Hasbro Studios screencap](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/mlp/images/7/7e/Bluebird_Happiness_ID_S1E11.png/revision/latest?cb=20110709061026)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/File:Bluebird_Happiness_ID_S1E11.png)

Bluebird Happiness is the *fan-named*, sky-blue Pegasus mare glimpsed with Ponyville’s weather team in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Look for her sea-green mane and tail, amber-orange eyes, and two-lightning-bolt cutie mark. Her only individually identified TV appearance is a brief shot in **“Winter Wrap Up” (S1E11)**; she resembles several recolors of the Sassaflash character design. [G4 Pegasus character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Pegasus_ponies)

*Name history:* “Bluebird Happiness” is a fandom identifier, not a spoken or confirmed Hasbro name. Fans once matched this green-maned pony to the **Sassaflash** mystery-pack toy, but a later yellow-maned toy variant led wiki editors to favor the similar lighter-coated pony formerly nicknamed “Wind Whistler” instead. The toy name is therefore **not a verified alias** for Bluebird Happiness. [Contemporary fan naming discussion](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Forum:ShowToyComparison)

*Speaking:* No identifiable solo lines or confirmed voice-actor credit. *Other appearances:* No further individually verified episode, film, or comic role.

*Fan creation:* [CINNAMON-STITCH’s Bluebird Happiness plush commission](https://cinnamon-stitch.deviantart.com/art/mlp-plushie-commission-Bluebird-Happiness-633492179) is a credited fan-made depiction, not another canon appearance.

## Important moments

- *Weather-team cameo — “Winter Wrap Up” (S1E11):* She appears among Ponyville’s pegasi helping change winter to spring. This is her one documented on-screen scene, not a speaking or plot-changing role. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zoOO4y81bvQ). *Timestamp unavailable:* a fan index gives approximately 19:08 in the episode, but that position was not verified in this upload.

No second character-defining scene is verifiable; adding one would mistake a lookalike for her.
